llm_response.reason: Fasset.com exhibits the traits of a legitimate fintech/crypto investment platform. Its domain registration dates back to 1999 with regular updates, and its content avoids guarantees of unrealistic returns, urgent calls to action, or manipulative schemes. The site provides risk disclaimers, links to reputable third-party media coverage, and has transparent communication about its services. While an SSL certificate issue was detected, no core scam characteristics are present. The website is therefore determined to be legitimate, with only a technical SSL issue evident.
